detail.body:
## What changes

Enable prefix caching for batch-invariant Mamba inference when KV blocks align with the SSM scan chunks. Previously this combination was rejected, and the batch-invariant mixer skipped publishing intermediate states.

Cache complete-chunk FP32 SSM states using the existing extraction path. Restored prefixes start at the same scan boundary as uncached prefill; suffix prefill initializes the partial-tail replay buffers. Keep the FP32-state and non-speculative-decode requirements, and reject misaligned cache block sizes.

Also fix cached suffix scheduling: a 600-token prompt with 512 cached tokens and an 88-token compute budget previously rounded to zero and could wait indefinitely. The scheduler now excludes the cached prefix when applying the compute budget, while returning the full request span.

## Validation

- Seven targeted GPU regressions passed on one GB200 with Transformer Engine 2.19: four graph/chunking combinations plus cache-alignment and scheduler tests.
- Tiny BF16 hybrid model compares generated tokens and log probabilities exactly against uncached eager inference, including reordered batches, aligned and one-token suffixes, warm cache hits, and invalidation after a weight update.
- Standalone all-features probe exercised 18 graph steps and skipped 1,536 cached prefix tokens with exact token/log-probability parity.
- Kernel determinism coverage check passes with the new parity test registered.
- On current main, a broader run passed 90 tests before stopping at two existing TP4/PP4 cases requiring four ranks (this run used one). The four new GPU parity cases passed again.

Local runtime uses NeMo-RL's existing compatibility shim to enable its installed FlashAttention 4 beta. Full-model and multi-GPU reproducibility remain to be validated; these tests do not establish invariance across TP/EP configurations.

Needed by the deterministic GRPO draft https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/RL/pull/4723. No dependency pins changed here.

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+"""Bitwise cache-hit parity, including chunked prefill, graph replay and refit."""
+
+import gc
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core.inference.config import InferenceConfig, MambaInferenceStateConfig
+from megatron.core.inference.contexts.dynamic_context import DynamicInferenceContext
+from megatron.core.inference.engines.dynamic_engine import DynamicInferenceEngine
+from megatron.core.inference.model_inference_wrappers.gpt.gpt_inference_wrapper import (
+    GPTInferenceWrapper,
+)
+from megatron.core.inference.sampling_params import SamplingParams
+from megatron.core.inference.text_generation_controllers.text_generation_controller import (
+    TextGenerationController,
+)
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_layer_specs import hybrid_stack_spec
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_model import HybridModel
+from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.random import model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed
+from megatron.core.transformer.cuda_graphs import delete_cuda_graphs
+from megatron.core.transformer.custom_layers.batch_invariant_kernels import (
+    set_batch_invariant_mode,
+    te_supports_batch_invariant_attention,
+)
+from megatron.core.transformer.enums import AttnBackend
+from megatron.core.transformer.module import Float16Module
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+from tests.unit_tests.inference.engines.ssm_test_helpers import (
+    skip_if_sequence_packing_not_available,
+)
+from tests.unit_tests.models.test_gpt_model_batch_invariant import (
+    HAVE_FA3,
+    HAVE_FA4,
+    DummyTokenizer,
+)
+from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+
+@pytest.mark.internal
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not te_supports_batch_invariant_attention() or not (HAVE_FA3 or HAVE_FA4),
+    reason="Requires batch-invariant TE and FA3/4",
+)
+class TestBatchInvariantMambaPrefixCaching:
+    def setup_method(self):
+        skip_if_sequence_packing_not_available()
+        Utils.initialize_model_parallel(1, 1)
+        self._previous_deterministic = torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled()
+        torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
+
+    def teardown_method(self):
+        delete_cuda_graphs()
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+        torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(self._previous_deterministic)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _run(*, prefix, graphs, chunked):
+        model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(321, inference_rng_tracker=True, force_reset_rng=True)
+        torch.manual_seed(321)
+        cfg = TransformerConfig(
+            num_layers=3,
+            hidden_size=128,
+            num_attention_heads=4,
+            is_hybrid_model=True,
+            mamba_num_heads=8,
+            mamba_head_dim=32,
+            mamba_num_groups=1,
+            mamba_state_dim=16,
+            use_cpu_initialization=True,
+            hidden_dropout=0.0,
+            attention_dropout=0.0,
+            batch_invariant_mode=True,
+            batch_invariant_backend="te_native",
+            flash_attention_version=4 if HAVE_FA4 else 3,
+            normalization="RMSNorm",
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            bf16=True,
+            attention_backend=AttnBackend.flash,
+            cuda_graph_impl="local" if graphs else "none",
+            inference_rng_tracker=True,
+        )
+        model = (
+            HybridModel(
+                config=cfg,
+                hybrid_stack_spec=hybrid_stack_spec,
+                hybrid_layer_pattern="M*-",
+                vocab_size=128,
+                max_sequence_length=1024,
+            )
+            .cuda()
+            .eval()
+        )
+        mamba_config = MambaInferenceStateConfig.from_model(model)
+        assert mamba_config.ssm_states_dtype == torch.float32
+        model = Float16Module(cfg, model).cuda().eval()
+        context = DynamicInferenceContext(
+            cfg,
+            InferenceConfig(
+                mamba_inference_state_config=mamba_config,
+                prefix_caching_mamba_gb=0.125,
+                max_sequence_length=1024,
+                buffer_size_gb=0.125,
+                block_size_tokens=256,
+                max_requests=4,
+                max_tokens=512 if chunked else 2048,
+                num_cuda_graphs=4 if graphs else None,
+                cuda_graph_max_tokens=256,
+                materialize_only_last_token_logits=True,
+                use_cuda_graphs_for_non_decode_steps=True,
+                enable_chunked_prefill=chunked,
+                enable_prefix_caching=prefix,
+                use_flashinfer_fused_rope=False,
+                unified_memory_level=0,
+                sampling_backend="torch",
+            ),
+        )
+        engine = DynamicInferenceEngine(
+            TextGenerationController(
+                GPTInferenceWrapper(model, context), DummyTokenizer(vocab_size=128, eod=127)
+            ),
+            context,
+        )
+        prompts = [[i % 120 + 1 for i in range(n)] for n in (600, 650, 512, 513, 768, 769)]
+        outputs = {}
+        graph_steps = 0
+        for wave, order in enumerate(([0, 1], [1, 0], [2], [3], [4], [5], [0])):
+            if wave == 6:
+                # Old cached states must not be reused after a weight update.
+                engine.suspend()
+                for parameter in model.parameters():
+                    parameter.mul_(1.03)
+                engine.resume()
+                skipped_before_refit_request = engine._prefill_tokens_skipped
+            for i in order:
+                engine.add_request(
+                    wave * 10 + i + 1,
+                    prompts[i],
+                    SamplingParams(
+                        seed=100 + i,
+                        num_tokens_to_generate=8,
+                        temperature=1.0,
+                        top_k=0,
+                        top_p=1.0,
+                        return_log_probs=True,
+                        skip_prompt_log_probs=True,
+                        termination_id=-1,
+                    ),
+                )
+            for _ in range(200):
+                if not engine.has_unfinished_requests():
+                    break
+                result = engine.step_modern()
+                graph_steps += int(context.using_cuda_graph_this_step())
+                for request in result["finished_requests"]:
+                    outputs[request.request_id] = (
+                        list(request.generated_tokens),
+                        list(request.generated_log_probs),
+                    )
+            assert not engine.has_unfinished_requests(), "Cached suffix made no scheduling progress"
+            if wave == 6:
+                assert engine._prefill_tokens_skipped == skipped_before_refit_request
+        assert outputs[1] == outputs[11]
+        assert outputs[2] == outputs[12]
+        if prefix:
+            assert engine._prefill_tokens_skipped > 0
+        if graphs:
+            assert graph_steps > 0
+        del engine, context, model
+        delete_cuda_graphs()
+        gc.collect()
+        return outputs
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("graphs", [False, True])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("chunked", [False, True])
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_cache_matches_uncached_eager(self, graphs, chunked, monkeypatch):
+        monkeypatch.setenv("MAMBA_DETERMINISTIC", "1")
+        monkeypatch.setenv("NVTE_FLASH_ATTN", "1")
+        monkeypatch.setenv("NVTE_FUSED_ATTN", "0")
+        monkeypatch.setenv("NVTE_UNFUSED_ATTN", "0")
+        with set_batch_invariant_mode(True, backend="te_native"):
+            baseline = self._run(prefix=False, graphs=False, chunked=False)
+            cached = self._run(prefix=True, graphs=graphs, chunked=chunked)
+        assert cached == baseline
